segment_rule_per_item_fields.name: segment_rule_per_item_fields
segment_rule_per_item_fields.value: "app"."segment_rule"."rule_kind" <> 'per_item' OR ("app"."segment_rule"."max_landed_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."segment_rule"."floor_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."segment_rule"."floor_cents" > 0 AND "app"."segment_rule"."floor_cents" <= "app"."segment_rule"."max_landed_cents")

segment_rule_per_gb_fields.name: segment_rule_per_gb_fields
segment_rule_per_gb_fields.value: "app"."segment_rule"."rule_kind" <> 'per_gb' OR ("app"."segment_rule"."max_cents_per_gb" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."segment_rule"."min_cents_per_gb" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."segment_rule"."min_total_gb" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."segment_rule"."min_cents_per_gb" > 0 AND "app"."segment_rule"."min_cents_per_gb" <= "app"."segment_rule"."max_cents_per_gb" AND "app"."segment_rule"."min_total_gb" > 0)

session_ended_reason.name: session_ended_reason
session_ended_reason.value: ("auth"."session"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("auth"."session"."end_reason" IS NULL) AND ("auth"."session"."end_reason" IS NULL OR "auth"."session"."end_reason" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,39}$')

listing_gone_reason_known.name: listing_gone_reason_known
listing_gone_reason_known.value: ("ebay_live"."listing"."gone_at" IS NULL) = ("ebay_live"."listing"."gone_reason" IS NULL) AND ("ebay_live"."listing"."gone_reason" IS NULL OR "ebay_live"."listing"."gone_reason" IN ('ended', 'unconfirmed', 'not_found'))

market_listing_condition_group_known.name: market_listing_condition_group_known
market_listing_condition_group_known.value: CASE WHEN "app"."market_listing"."condition_group" IS NULL THEN "app"."market_listing"."excluded_reason" IS NOT NULL ELSE "app"."market_listing"."condition_group" IN ('new', 'open_box', 'refurbished', 'used') END

product_condition_ids_format.name: product_condition_ids_format
product_condition_ids_format.value: cardinality("app"."product"."condition_ids") BETWEEN 1 AND 15 AND array_position("app"."product"."condition_ids", NULL) IS NULL AND array_to_string("app"."product"."condition_ids", ',') ~ '^[0-9]{4}(,[0-9]{4})*$'

product_list_sizes.name: product_list_sizes
product_list_sizes.value: cardinality("app"."product"."search_words") BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND cardinality("app"."product"."exclude_words") <= 60 AND cardinality("app"."product"."warn_words") <= 30 AND cardinality("app"."product"."junk_exceptions") <= 20 AND cardinality("app"."product"."alert_recipient_ids") <= 20

product_must_words_shape.name: product_must_words_shape
product_must_words_shape.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("app"."product"."must_words") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("app"."product"."must_words") BETWEEN 1 AND 6 ELSE false END

product_per_gb_units.name: product_per_gb_units
product_per_gb_units.value: NOT "app"."product"."per_gb" OR ("app"."product"."unit_min_total" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."product"."unit_max_total" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."product"."unit_min_total" > 0 AND "app"."product"."unit_max_total" >= "app"."product"."unit_min_total")

product_below_market_pct.name: product_below_market_pct
product_below_market_pct.value: ("app"."product"."price_mode" = 'below_market') = ("app"."product"."below_market_pct" IS NOT NULL) AND ("app"."product"."below_market_pct" IS NULL OR "app"."product"."below_market_pct" BETWEEN 1 AND 90)

product_source_ka_fields.name: product_source_ka_fields
product_source_ka_fields.value: ("app"."product_source"."source" = 'kleinanzeigen' OR ("app"."product_source"."ka_saved_search_id" IS NULL AND "app"."product_source"."ka_price_limit_cents" IS NULL)) AND ("app"."product_source"."ka_price_limit_cents" IS NULL OR "app"."product_source"."ka_price_limit_cents" > 0)

search_condition_ids_format.name: search_condition_ids_format
search_condition_ids_format.value: cardinality("app"."search"."condition_ids") BETWEEN 1 AND 15 AND array_position("app"."search"."condition_ids", NULL) IS NULL AND array_to_string("app"."search"."condition_ids", ',') ~ '^[0-9]{4}(,[0-9]{4})*$'
